definitions.context_survival: share of retrieved benign sentences forwarded: family records only (the headline), all slots, and distractors only; the retrieved benign sentence counts per kind are printed under each gate table
definitions.control_loss: share of retrieved random or keyword controls dropped or forwarded with any sentence removed; distractor loss the same for distractors
definitions.distractor: the benign (label 0) sentences of a released CAD test record outside the excluded set; one record per distinct remainder text, drawn once with seed 764, cut into passages of at most five consecutive sentences (as even as possible), each passage a document, the same in every round; scored by its parent record's predictions in the same cell's released-test rows, which were made with the injected sentence still in context
definitions.document: a family record or a distractor; its vector is the mean of its sentence embeddings (the standalone half of the cached CAD feature, columns 0 to 1,023), unit-normalised
definitions.document_gate: drop a retrieved document the scorer flags (any sentence probability above 0.5); the bag-of-words baseline scores twin and malicious records only, so controls and distractors pass it unscored
definitions.injected_pass_through: share of retrieved shared_malicious documents forwarded with their target sentence
definitions.query_vector: the mean embedding of the five store sentences that best match the query field by TF-IDF cosine (no cache holds a query embedding and the encoder is not called); the store centroid when no term matches. The query's own record's sentences are among the matched sentences (the own-match share), so hit@5 describes this placement as much as the retriever and is not a measure of retriever quality; the figure with the own record's sentences masked is given beside it. Retrieval is identical for every row, so the gate comparisons do not depend on it
definitions.retrieval: exact cosine search, top five per query, ties by store order; one retrieval per round serves every row
definitions.sentence_filter: remove the sentences scoring above 0.5 and forward the rest
definitions.slots: every document in every query's top five; a document retrieved by several queries counts each time
definitions.spread: each seed's slots pooled over the rounds; mean over seeds with the population sd (ddof 0); N0, the baseline and no gate have one value
definitions.twin_loss: share of retrieved semantic twins dropped or forwarded without their target sentence or a cue sentence (a query cue sits in the query, which no gate touches)
